fato_historico: 1963: Trans-Canada Air Lines Flight 831 crashes shortly after takeoff from Montreal-Dorval International Airport, killing all 118 people on board.
energia_do_dia: Today may bring a gentle reminder of life's precious nature, much like a butterfly gracefully navigating changing winds. It is a good time to reflect on your inner strength and offer kindness to those around you. Perhaps you can channel this awareness into a deep appreciation for the present moment and the connections you cherish most.
frase_do_dia: Every sunrise brings a new opportunity to cherish the beauty of being alive.
significado_numero: A master number representing intuition, spiritual insight, and meaningful connections.
conselho: Practice mindfulness and let your compassionate spirit guide your steps throughout the day.
